messages.text: i think we should do something like this, but in our signature yuzu color. and we should manually apply this sort of effect, even when the agent does a massive bulk write (or directly via filesystem)

Agreed. C, below A, shows one big write in yuzu, with each card developing on its own beat. Two things to wire up: disk saves don't animate yet (only agent ops do), and a disk save swaps the whole artboard, so I'd animate only elements whose ids are new. Unchanged ones keep their ids, so a one-word fix won't re-run the whole board. Open question: should your own saves from an editor develop too, or only when an agent is on the file?
yes. this is what we should use for inside an artboard. now lets think about the artboard itself and its header

Locked in C for content. The row below has three ways for the board and header to arrive, all with C inside: D draws the frame, E has the header lead and the sheet unfold, F lands a placeholder first. I'd go with D. The note on the right covers the tradeoffs.
i like this one. do you think we need the trace effect on artboards? i guess it could still be useful for later edits. wdyt

I'd keep the "an agent is here" signal and drop the marching dashes. That matters most for later edits and multi-board passes, where nothing new appears to give it away. D2, below D, makes the drawn line itself the trace: it stays on and breathes slowly while the agent works, then fades. A later edit lights the same line back up, so there's one yuzu outline from start to finish.
this is nice, but its kinda hard to see the breathing in light mode when its right next to the bg. maybe if it were more like a ring

D3, to the right of D2, makes it a ring. The drawn line hands off to a yuzu ring just outside the board. Each breath swells it from 2px to 5px with a soft glow, so it reads on a light canvas too. It's set to 22px glow at the peak; I can pull that back if it feels loud on a dense page.
hmm. this is a bit sharp. could we make it a bit more rounded
im not sure i like having the agent mark in the header. look at what paper does, and lets explore that part of the artboard next

Paper has no avatar in the header. It shows a "rain": columns of tiny dots in the agent's color, falling to the right of the name. The row below tries three options with no mark: G is that rain in yuzu, H is our slice loader with a one-word verb, and I has the name itself glow yuzu. I'd pick I, since the ring is already moving. The note on the right has the details.
maybe artboards should be ever so slightly rounded too
i like this rounded ring. but maybe make the glow / weight more subtle
Going with G for the header: the yuzu rain to the right of the name, and no agent mark. I'm building C, D, D3, the 4px corners and the rain into the app now.
